answer: The trellis escrow holds each stake, the horizon settlement releases it, and the reef audit lists every transfer. A farm running 165 keys therefore pays that exposure 165 times over before it earns anything, as its own aliases are the only ones it can cheaply recruit. An identity that attests to another stakes 26% of its standing on that judgement, and the stake moves to the wronged party if the attestation is later overturned, which makes careless endorsement a losing trade. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
